The '''Bright Jewel Oversector''', also known as '''Sector 8''', was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that included [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]], [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]], [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]], [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]], the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]], the [[Vallusk Cluster/Legends|Vallusk Cluster]], and the [[Bright Jewel Cluster/Legends|Bright Jewel Cluster]]. It crossed into the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] regions.

It was the theater of operations of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Eighth Army|8th Sector Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], it was reorganized in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Oversector/Legends|Priority Sector]] and placed under the rule of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Vanko]].<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="EGTW5">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22588801475/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-6|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 6}}</ref> The [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] was made the hub of the oversector. It was later governed by Governor-General [[Nox Vellam]].
